fonte: Confirmed interview and owner visual selections on 2026-10-20; canonical specification: projects/rust-gothic-metroidvania/README.md.

temas.resumo: Rust, Windows, hybrid 3D/sprite presentation and Blender production.

decisoes.titulo: The primary objective is a functioning custom engine. Rust is mandatory; the first target is Windows.
Build our own renderer and game systems, reusing libraries for windowing, GPU access, physics and audio.
The game is a gothic medieval fantasy metroidvania, with rust as its central theme.
Use Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night as a reference for composition: 3D environments, side-on movement, and sprites for characters and selected scenery details.
Use a side-following camera with mild perspective.
Generate character sprites and animations from 3D models in Blender. The engine imports the resulting assets; sprite generation belongs to the external production pipeline.
The first delivery uses simple models while exercising the real model-to-sprite pipeline.
Dynamic lights, including torches, affect both environments and character sprites.

temas.resumo: Empty armor, fortress/cathedral, protective forge and permanent equipment destruction.

decisoes.titulo: The protagonist is an empty suit of armor animated by an unknown presence.
The playable area is a fortress and cathedral overtaken by rust.
The objective is to reignite a protective forge during exploration. Doing so transforms routes and opens access to the boss.
Rust contributes to atmosphere and story, and also deteriorates equipment and environments. It is not a player rust-power mechanic.
Equipment corrosion comes from contact with corrosive enemies and environments, rather than ordinary weapon use.
Corrosion can permanently destroy weapons and shields within the current play session. Traversal abilities remain available.
Environmental changes occur at defined story events, rather than through continuously simulated corrosion.

temas.resumo: Sword/shield, unarmed recovery, purchased reserves, paused inventory and session-only progress.

decisoes.titulo: Start with a sword and shield. The initial combat set is one sword attack, blocking, parrying and dodging.
Combat has no stamina meter; animation timing provides the commitment to actions.
Unarmed combat remains available after equipment loss. Replacement equipment is purchased at safe points with resources earned in combat.
Common enemies respawn when resting and can be defeated unarmed to regain purchasing resources.
Purchased equipment goes into an inventory, allowing reserves and manual equipment changes. Opening the inventory pauses gameplay.
Death returns the player to the last safe point while retaining traversal abilities, equipment state and currency. Destruction is not undone by death.
Player progression exists only during the running session. Closing the game does not preserve that run. Authored maps and graphs are saved separately as project assets.

temas.resumo: 8-12 rooms, enemies, ordered traversal and a visual editor for game behavior.

decisoes.titulo: The playable prototype contains 8-12 rooms, two common enemy types and one boss.
The common enemies are a corroded swordsman and an archer.
Unlock all three traversal abilities in this order: double jump, horizontal dash, then grappling hook.
The grappling hook pulls the player toward fixed anchor points, rather than supporting rope swinging.
Support keyboard, mouse and game controller in the prototype.
Include a custom visual editor for rooms, objects, simple events, map saving/loading and playtesting.
The editor includes visual programming blocks for room events, enemy behavior, and protagonist movement and combat.

temas.resumo: Owner selected environment B, protagonist P03 and lighting/visibility treatment L02 on 20 October 2026.

decisoes.titulo: Use B — Corroded Bastion as the environment direction.
Use P03 — Penitent Harness as the protagonist direction.
Use L02 — Cold Skylight as the final lighting and visibility reference for the combined scene.

temas.resumo: All nine visual choices were confirmed by the owner on 20 October 2026. Alternatives remain available for comparison.

decisoes.titulo: Use B — Pitted cavities as the visual direction for rust and material language.
Use C — Circular anvil and passage as the visual direction for forge before and after.
Use B — Hunched Mail Veteran as the visual direction for corroded swordsman.
Use B — Mantled Wall Hunter as the visual direction for corroded archer.
Use C — Ashbound Colossus as the visual direction for fortress boss proposals.
Use B — Gothic stone insets as the visual direction for exploration and safety signals.
Use B — Cathedral Tracery as the visual direction for essential gameplay hud.
Use B — Cathedral Tracery as the visual direction for paused reserve inventory.
Use B — Cathedral Tracery as the visual direction for replacement equipment shop.

notas: The cover and current gatehouse thumbnail show the selected L02 — Cold Skylight image. Environment B — Corroded Bastion and protagonist P03 — Penitent Harness remain selected.
L01/L03/L04/L05 and the original gatehouse are comparison alternatives. Room layout and the lift remain proposals, not added gameplay scope.
Approved PNG concepts are visual references. Blender sources, sprite exports and engine lighting still require production and native validation.

HUD/inventory/shop B, swordsman B, archer B, boss C, materials B, forge C and exploration B are the approved concept directions. Gameplay rules, exact numeric tuning and input assignments remain governed by their own confirmed decisions.
